notes: Zero-point achievements. Badges never contribute to the score, never gate attestation, and are deliberately kept out of spec.json — that file is the scoring contract the engine and the EAS attestation are built from.

badges.name: Launched a Talent Token
badges.description: Deployed a personal Talent Token through Talent Protocol's v1 TalentFactory.
badges.notes: The Celo factory never populated the talent → token direction: talentsToTokens returns 0x0 even for wallets whose createTalent succeeded, and hasTalentToken reverts. Only Polygon answers a live per-wallet read, and it holds 20 of the 564 talents. So the badge matches against the factories' TalentCreated history instead — public chain data, regenerated by scripts/build-talent-token-allowlist.mjs, frozen because both factories have been dormant since July 2023.

badges.name: $BUILD Contributor
badges.description: Donated to the BUILD airdrop on Base.
badges.notes: Checked both ways and earned either way, because neither sees the whole picture. The onchain donated() accumulator only records wallets that donated directly to the contract. The snapshot carries the pay-it-forward donors — people who gave their BUILD allocation away — whose donation was recorded in the BUILD airdrop database rather than in that accumulator. Both sides of each pair are exported, since the donation sits on the custody wallet and custody wallets are not linked accounts, so they appear nowhere else. Exported profile-wide so any wallet a person owns matches. The export also reads the stored build_contribution data point, but that yields nothing today: the credential row was deleted when it was retired from the 2025 set, and data points cascade with it. The query stays in place for the day it returns.

badges.name: Builder Score 100+
badges.description: Reached a Builder Score of 100 or more on Talent Protocol.
badges.notes: Builder Score lives in Talent Protocol's database with no permissionless read, so this badge is a dated export rather than a live check.

badges.name: Earned Builder Rewards
badges.description: Received a completed Builder Rewards payout from a Talent Protocol grant.
badges.notes: Rewards are paid from a per-grant wallet through a per-grant multisend contract, so there is no stable distributor address to check onchain.
